AmaDouro Review

Review of AmaDouro

The 2019-built MS AmaDouro cruises on Portugal's Douro River, departing from Oporto. While the cruise tours embark in Porto, booking options are available with departures from either Lisbon or Madrid. The itinerary follows the scenic Douro River Valley, Portugal's premier wine-producing region known as Alto Douro.

Like most top-luxury riverboats in Portugal, AmaDouro is operated through a partnership between AmaWaterways (a US company), the Portuguese cruisetour company Mystic Cruises (the shipowner), and DouroAzul (the co-operator).

MS AmaDouro is a customized version of the Concerto-class design, built specifically for Douro River cruising. Her design prioritizes elegance, spacious accommodations, and extensive public areas, incorporating several features uncommon on riverboats.

The vessel is Portugal-flagged (MMSI number 263752970) and registered in Lisbon. She was built by WestSEA shipyard in Viana do Castelo, Portugal.

AmaDouro's sisterships are AmaVida (2013) and AmaSintra (2025).

Cabins

AmaDouro has a total of 51 passenger staterooms, including 2 Suites, 36 Balcony cabins, and 15 with non-opening windows.

Most cabins are 20 m² (215 ft²) and feature private step-out balconies with floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors. Suites are more spacious at 30 m² (325 ft²). There are six cabin categories, with each accommodating up to two guests.

All staterooms include a private bathroom with a glass-door shower, multi-jet shower head, hairdryer, and premium bath amenities. Additional in-room features include a mirrored vanity table with chair, wardrobe, wireless phone, electronic safe (in the closet), two long-range portable Wi-Fi audio devices (for excursions), daily replenished bottled water, and thermostat-controlled air conditioning. Suites also offer a sitting area with a full-size sofa, a table with two chairs, a mini-bar, and a large bathroom with a full-size bathtub.

Each cabin is equipped with a 42-inch HDTV (local and satellite reception, movies-on-demand) and an infotainment system with complimentary in-room Internet and real-time bridge cam views.

Cabin Categories (by type, location, and quantity):

  • Suites - SU (x2, Deck 3) - 323 ft² / 30 m²
  • Balcony Staterooms - A (x18, Deck 3), B (x14, Deck 2), C (x4, Deck 2) - 215 ft² / 20 m²
  • RiverView Staterooms - D (x8, Deck 1), E (x8, Deck 1) - 161 ft² / 15 m²

Shipboard Facilities

Dining options include the main Douro Restaurant, the outdoor "Al Fresco" (32 seats), and casual dining in the Bar Lounge and on the Sun Deck. Guests enjoy gourmet cuisine featuring international and traditional Portuguese specialties, with premium service and open-air dining. Complimentary local wines are served during lunch and dinner.

Additional onboard amenities include the Main Lounge & Bar (connected to a teak Front Deck terrace), Douro Lobby, Gift Shop, and a wellness complex with a Spa (Sauna and Treatment Rooms) and Fitness Center. The top deck offers a swimming pool, sun loungers, a shaded seating area with deckchairs, and a helipad.

AmaDouro cruise fares include alcoholic and soft beverages, unlimited Wi-Fi/Internet, guided tours and excursions, land transfers, live evening entertainment by local performers, daily enrichment lectures, food and wine tastings, and 24-hour coffee/tea service with snacks and fresh juices.

River cruise prices are per person based on double occupancy and are indicative only. Actual fares may vary depending on special offers, promotions, group bookings, or last-minute deals.

AmaWaterways also offers discounted airfare travel deals on major airlines, without charging flight deviation fees.

River Cruise Itineraries

AmaDouro sails exclusively on the Douro River with roundtrip departures from the homeport of Oporto/Porto City.

The primary AmaDouro itinerary is themed "ENTICING DOURO," offering 12-day cruises (7 sailing days) from Porto. The itinerary includes a 3-night luxury hotel stay in Lisbon, followed by guided tours and then the cruise. Guests enjoy seven complimentary land excursions.

Itinerary Overview:

Date / TimePort
DAY 1Departing from Oporto
DAY 2Entre-os-Rios
DAY 3Regua and Pinhao
DAY 4Vega de Terron / Salamanca, Spain
DAY 5Barca d'Alva and Pinhao
DAY 6Pinhao
DAY 7Regua
DAY 8Arriving in Oporto

Prices start at approximately USD 3000 per person.

"PORT WINE and FLAMENCO" is a 15-day Portugal and Spain river voyage (7 days sailing), available from Lisbon to Madrid, or in reverse. This package includes nine complimentary land excursions, as well as 3-night luxury hotel stays in both Lisbon and Madrid.

AmaDouro Wiki

AmaDouro is the second of three AmaWaterways ships (alongside sisterships AmaVida and AmaSintra) offering luxury river cruises in Portugal.

The vessel is operated by AmaWaterways' "AmaVoyages" division in partnership with DouroAzul, a Portuguese cruisetour company founded in 1993.

AmaDouro features a newly modified riverboat design tailored specifically to the Douro River—one of the Iberian Peninsula’s major waterways. Originating near Duruelo de la Sierra in Spain and flowing westward to Oporto in Portugal, the Douro is renowned for its port wine production. The entire Douro Valley region is recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with its scenic landscape defined by vineyard estates climbing the steep, terraced hillsides of the Upper Douro Valley.

Designed by CMT Engineering Ltd, AmaDouro combines a sleek modern appearance with unique features, including onboard mini-helicopter tours. As part of its eco-conscious engineering, the ship is equipped with solar panels (photovoltaic awning roof panels covering a total area of 155 m² / 1670 ft²) and a hybrid diesel-electric propulsion system. A highlight of AmaWaterways’ cruise experience in Portugal is the complimentary bike tours, with onboard bicycles available for use during all guided excursions in the itinerary ports.

The ship’s christening ceremony took place on April 12, 2019, in Porto City, Portugal. The ceremony was led by godmother Julia Lo Bue-Said, CEO of Advantage Travel Partnership (the UK’s largest group of independent travel agents). The vessel is captained by Pedro Sardo.
